                  aria-label={config.title}
                  className={`${PREFIX}-input`}
                  type="number"
                  min={config.minimum}
                  max={config.maximum}
                  step={config.multipleOf}
                  value={String(value)}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleChange(key, (e.target as HTMLInputElement).valueAsNumber)
                  }
                />
